messages:
kelsey: heads-up — our canary in eu-west is seeing a surge of TLS handshake failures starting ~08:02 UTC after the RBAC tighten we rolled at 08:00. failures look like clientSNI -> server handshake aborts. :eyes:

incident-bot: alert: TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERROR spike on service=keystore-api region=eu-west count=127 duration=5m

dmitri: seeing `KMSDecryptPermissionDenied` in keystore-fetch logs. stack traces show `keystore-service` failing to fetch intermediate certs from keystore-store (via the private API). sample log:

```
ERROR keystore.fetch - Unable to unwrap key for cert-chain: AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:kms:eu-west:...:key/... cannot be used to decrypt
at com.redwood.keystore.KMSClient.unwrap(KMSClient.java:87)
```

maria: RBAC change PR #4523 removed `keystore-reader` role from the `platform-service-accounts` group as part of scope-hardening. That group includes the EC2 role used by keystore-rotator. Possibly rolled too strict.

ben: confirm: the rotator pod now gets 403 when hitting keystore-store? or is KMS itself denying? I see both `403` from keystore-store and KMS AccessDenied in the same window.

kelsey: both — keystore-store retries with `403` and eventually KMS throws AccessDenied. My hypothesis: RBAC removal blocked rotator from calling the keystore-store read endpoint, so the rotator fell back to direct KMS unwrap path which it does under a different service account that lacks decrypt permission. Either way certs not available => downstream proxies fail mTLS.

sre-oncall: quick mitigation: re-add `keystore-reader` to platform-service-accounts in eu-west IAM binding and restart rotator. That should re-enable normal path. ETA 10m if we get approval.

maria: approved. rolling `gcloud iam roles bindings update` now for eu-west namespaces and restarting rotator pods. Will push change to canary first only.

incident-bot: action: role-binding-update initiated by maria — canary namespace updated at 08:16 UTC

ben: after restart, TLS handshake error rate dropped immediately on canary. patch seems effective. we should still follow up on why fallback path attempted KMS unwrap. that code path should have explicit feature-flag and audits.

kelsey: root-cause notes for postmortem: 1) RBAC hardening removed read binding from a platform group used by rotator. 2) rotator has a silent fallback to direct KMS unwrap when keystore-store returns 403 — no alerting on fallback. 3) audit logs for the keystore-store read attempt were noisy and not correlated with KMS AccessDenied events in our existing alert rules.

dmitri: items: - Add alert when keystore-store returns >=5 403s within 1m for same service account. - Break out `KMSDecryptPermissionDenied` as a distinct alert. - Add an invariant test in infra that validates platform-service-accounts retains `keystore-reader` during RBAC rollouts across regions.

maria: question for security/compliance: do we need to backfill audit logs for every failed unwrap attempt? compliance wants a complete chain for Oct 2 incidents. current logging retained request-id but not mapped to user principal after role removal.

kelsey: yes, we need to produce mapping. quick approach: export keystore-store and rotator logs (08:00–08:30 UTC) and correlate by request-id and instance-id. then map instance -> IAM role -> group membership snapshot from infra state at 07:59 UTC (we have infra-config history).

ben: also flag: TLS config hardening note — some edge proxies had `session-ticket` enabled and when certs were temporarily missing clients retried and session-resume attempts hit mis-matched SNI routing. Suggest we temporarily disable session-ticket-based resume for canary while this gets stabilized.

sre-oncall: changed edge-proxy config for canary to `disable_session_tickets: true` at 08:28 UTC. Proxy errors cleared quicker after that.

kelsey: follow-ups (owner tags): - infra: @maria add invariant test + rollback guard (owner: maria) - sec-eng: @kelsey add RBAC rollout checklist to ensure service-account coverage (owner: kelsey) - runtime: @dmitri add fallback/alerting and prevent silent KMS unwrap fallback (owner: dmitri) - compliance: @ben prepare audit package and correlated logs (owner: ben)

maria: will open rollback PR with a guard script that blocks RBAC merge if it would remove any of a whitelisted set of platform bindings.

dmitri: for KMS: we should ensure the rotator authenticates using the keystore-store proxy path only, and requires an explicit environment flag `ALLOW_DIRECT_KMS_UNWRAP` set to `true` to opt into direct unwrap for emergencies. will add config and a kill-switch.

ben: for postmortem, include metrics: handshake_error_rate (pre-change 0.02%, spike to 1.8%), keystore-store 403 count, KMS AccessDenied count, and SNI-mismatch logs.

kelsey: thanks team. I'll draft an incident summary and link to remediation PRs. tagging this as Sev3, will escalate if we see recurrence in other regions. :thumbsup:
